urls.title: LinkedIn URLs
urls.description: Public LinkedIn profile (/in/...) or company (/company/...) URLs - one per line. Authenticated surfaces (people search, employee lists) are not supported. API alias: startUrls.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel pages. LinkedIn is very sensitive to traffic patterns - keep at 1-2.
maxConcurrency.sectionDescription: Lower values are slower but much less likely to trigger sign-in walls.

includeRawText.title: Include raw text snippet
includeRawText.description: Add a 1000-character raw text snippet of the page to each item (useful for custom enrichment pipelines).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: RESIDENTIAL proxies are strongly recommended for LinkedIn. Consider a proxy country matching the profiles' region.
